info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Retail Orders Returns-v4-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Returns Retrieval API provides a streamlined method for fetching information on returned retail orders. This endpoint allows businesses to track and manage returned items efficiently, ensuring they can optimize their inventory and customer service processes. Typical consumers of this API include retail management systems and customer service platforms that need to access return data for analysis or resolution. With robust querying capabilities, this API supports various use cases involving return handling and reporting.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve a list of return orders. It can be used to track items that customers have returned, providing necessary data for processing refunds or exchanges.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to retrieve order return details. Ensure that the data is structured according to the defined schema.

200.description: Successful retrieval of return order details.

ListRetailOrdersReturnsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to order returns. It is expected to be a string that contains relevant information regarding the order return request.

status.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the order return.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the order return operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the order return operation.

ListRetailOrdersReturnsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the successful retrieval of order return operations.

createdBy.description: Identifier for the user who created the record.
